1. Put 160 g Rolled oats and all 500 ml Milk in a saucepan with about 200 ml water. Bring just to a gentle simmer and stir over low heat 6–8 minutes, or the oat packet's time, until soft and creamy; do not scorch the milk. Add a little hot water if too thick.
